name: CataTQA
description: CataTQA is a benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented LLM question answering over heterogeneous catalysis tables, focusing on table location, column retrieval, condition analysis, tool invocation, and question answering in scientific domains.
reputation: A niche benchmark in scientific QA over catalysis tables, mainly of interest to tool-augmented and scientific LLM evaluation researchers.
notes: Includes an automated dataset framework and four auxiliary tools; publicly available data and code.
